prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"Hi, I am looking for a cheap bottle of white wine. Can you help me find one?"

List A:
Wine 1: Pinot Noir, US, $20. Tasting note: "A pretty good Pinot that, at the equivalent of 10 bucks a bottle, is a nice buy. It's an easy wine, dry, light-bodied and silky, with modest cherry and spice flavors."
Wine 2: Sauvignon Blanc, Chile, $8. Tasting note: "Sometimes you just need a cheap, quaffable, crisp dry white wine to drink in copious amounts, and this one will do just fine, thank you. It's citrusy, spicy, and dry, and has enough acid to cleanse the palate."
Wine 3: White Blend, US, $10. Tasting note: "For 10 bucks you get a decent, 10 buck wine. Nothing fancy, just fruity, off-dry and crisply drinkable."
Wine 4: Sauvignon Blanc, US, $20. Tasting note: "It's rare to get a white wine from Cabernet-centric Rutherford, but Voss does a good job with this dry, crisp, low-alcohol Sauvignon Blanc. You can taste the coolness of the vintage in the tangy acidity and the gooseberry-accented citrus, fig and white pepper flavors."
Wine 5: Pinot Noir, US, $18. Tasting note: "Don't discount this Pinot Noir because it's in a screw top and the price is under $20. It's quite a nice wine, dry and silky. Made in a lighter style to be opened now, it has pleasant cherry, cola and sandalwood flavors."

List B:
Wine 1: Fumé Blanc, US, $12. Tasting note: "Great price for this unoaked white wine. It's smooth and crisp in mouthwatering acidity, with ripe flavors of citrus fruits, lemongrass, minerals and vanilla that finish with a honeyed richness. Easy to find, with production of 21,696 cases."
Wine 2: Pinot Gris, US, $12. Tasting note: "Good price for a white wine this classy. At first it tastes a little sweet, with jammy apricot and pineapple fruit flavors, but the acidity is so good, it leaves behind a clean, dry aftertaste."
Wine 3: Sauvignon Blanc, US, $12. Tasting note: "Good price for a crisp white wine that's this polished. Nice on its own for the savory citrus, spearmint and spicy vanilla flavors, and fine with everything from fried chicken to Cantonese."
Wine 4: Sauvignon Blanc, US, $15. Tasting note: "This is an innocuous, flowery and lemony white wine priced to sell that offers a creamy texture amid a light body and soul. For picnics and larger gatherings, it'll represent well."
Wine 5: White Blend, US, $10. Tasting note: "A superb white wine, and at this price, buy it by the case. Made from Chardonnay, Chenin Blanc and Gewürztraminer, it's streamlined and dry, with racy acidity framing citrus, lychee, pear, honeysuckle, mineral and spice flavors. Production was 10,000 cases, and the alcohol is a low 12.5%."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
